questions.question: Who voiced the Genie in Disney's "Aladdin"?
What is lost in Hawaiian and is also the name of a little girl in a 2002 film which features a alien named "Stitch"?
What was the name of the sea witch in the 1989 Disney film "The Little Mermaid"?
Which singer provided the voice of Metroid's Mother Brain in the animated series "Captain N: The Game Master"?
In the "Star Wars" universe, what species is Grand Admiral Thrawn?
In the classic children's show "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood," what is the name of the magical land where King Friday and Queen Sara rule?
questions.explanation: The Neighborhood of Make-Believe is the whimsical puppet kingdom within "Mister Rogers' Neighborhood," ruled by King Friday XIII and Queen Sara Saturday. Characters like Lady Aberlin, Daniel Tiger, and many others lived there and often gathered to discuss various topics and life lessons. It was a beloved segment of the long-running PBS children's series hosted by Fred Rogers.

questions.question: What is the title of the 2019 Disney animated sequel that is considered the No. 1 animated film of all time at the box office?
questions.explanation: Frozen 2, released in November 2019, became the No. 1 animated film of all time at the global box office, earning over $1.4 billion worldwide. It continues the story of Elsa, Anna, Kristoff, and Olaf as they journey beyond Arendelle to uncover the origin of Elsa's magical powers. Its record-breaking success cemented the Frozen franchise as one of Disney's most beloved animated properties.

questions.question: In classic Looney Tunes cartoons, which character exploits Yosemite Sam's cockiness by daring him to step across a line — a challenge the hot-headed cowboy can never refuse?
questions.explanation: Bugs Bunny is a master of psychological trickery, and one of his signature moves against Yosemite Sam is drawing a line and daring him to cross it. Sam's pride and inability to back down from any challenge makes him fall for the gag repeatedly, often leading to his own downfall. It's a classic example of Bugs winning through wit rather than brawn.

questions.question: Which long-running Fox animated series made the landmark switch from traditional cel animation with hand-drawn inbetweens to fully digital animation in 2002?
questions.explanation: In 2002, The Simpsons transitioned from hand-drawn cel animation — the classic technique used since its 1989 debut — to digital animation, joining a growing wave of TV cartoons making the same shift. This change streamlined production and allowed for more consistent coloring and compositing. Despite the technical overhaul, the show maintained its signature visual style so seamlessly that most viewers never noticed the difference.
